habits.boundary_condition: Do not infer one universal time window for all flight legs; the preferred window can vary by leg or trip, so honor any explicitly stated morning, afternoon, evening, or nighttime preference.
habits.condition: When searching or narrowing flight departure times.
habits.default_action: Search within the user’s requested time-of-day window first and present candidate times inside that window; if needed, ask about nearby windows instead of treating the initial timing as a fixed exact-time requirement.
habits.exception_condition: If the requested window has poor availability or conflicts with other stated flight constraints, confirm before broadening or switching to another window.
habits.name: Flexible departure-time windows
habits.preference_value: The traveler tends to work with broad time-of-day departure windows rather than fixed exact clock times; afternoon is often acceptable, but should not be assumed for every leg.
habits.rationale: Across three independent flight dialogues, the user frames departure timing as dayparts and requests or accepts options within or near those windows rather than requiring a single exact departure time.

source_evidence.contribution: Shows an afternoon departure window with tolerance for nearby times rather than a fixed exact clock time.
